_comment: Upstream sources for `npm run sync`. Each entry binds a YAML codelist to
an upstream + fetcher. Lists without an entry are skipped (UN/CEFACT lists
have no clean machine-readable upstream and change rarely).
format 'cldr'    — Unicode CLDR JSON (cldr-json on a CDN). Permissive
country/currency names come from here, NOT Debian
fetcher pulls one file per declared locale.
both regenerated wholesale by `npm run sync -- --schemes`.
`codes` decides which codes each list carries: the sets the
EN 16931 rules accept (BR-CL-10/11 ICD, BR-CL-25 EAS). Pinned to
a CEN release: bump it together with the validators that use
these lists. Names: ISO 6523 names first, then Peppol, then KoSIT
(EAS-only codes). Country: Peppol, joined by code. Editorial
additions (preferred, hints, translated labels) live in
data/overlays/schemes.yaml, never in the generated YAML.
